material.locator: OECD “Social Policy”, Key messages on social spending; linked OECD “Social Spending” indicator, Definition: cash benefits, in-kind goods and services, and tax breaks with a social purpose; eligible groups include low-income households, older people, disabled, unemployed, sick and young people. https://www.oecd.org/en/data/indicators/social-spending.html
material.description: Supports the listed categories of social spending; OECD's statistical definition is a comparative measurement framework, not an individual benefit entitlement.
